scope: Durable first creation and same-host serialization with compatibility autosave/close cleanup; public immutable storage and registered batch gates remain false
properties: Actual empty session is reserved before private preparation; close or replacement is never recreated at publication
File absence is admitted before preparation; existing pending records are preserved without building a replacement
Full durable bytes precede one exact sealed publication and remain pending after subsequent failures
Session object, revision, policy generation and persistence-owner identity are checked before write and publication
The checked file lease spans final publication; failed publication restores live session state and preserves pending durable bytes
Same-host nonblocking legacy lease spans snapshot and actual write/unlink, and first namespace creation uses the same owner lease
Ordinary compatibility autosave introduces no typed directory when none exists
The gated strict HTTP branch returns scalar metadata and exposes no mutable Design alias
limits: No cross-process guarantee for legacy writers or arbitrary external filesystem changes
Live workspace reconfiguration is not implemented; exact owner changes refuse creation or recovery
Durable lifecycle correctness is distinct from latency and total process-memory qualification
Existing private ephemeral creation helper remains for internal storage tests, separate from durable public creation
artifacts: Only pytest-owned temporary storage and small sentinel files; no application lifespan, production cache thread or user workspace
